notes: Era is not stated but is surely NS (Newari script, Patan). NS 604 Māgha śukla 5 falls in Jan/Feb 1484 CE. The weekday and nakṣatra were not checked. Lacunae before 'kṣetrapra' and in the locality ('śrīmāni + + + ne śrīkovihāre bhava(hlaḍhe)ye (ku)ligṛha'). 'Kovihāra' may be Kva Bāhāḥ (Hiraṇyavarṇa Mahāvihāra), Patan, but this is uncertain.
